notes.title: 2025/4/14「Correction of defect」ver.1.0.2
notes.notes: Fixed a problem in which the ticket gates could be passed through without a MetroCard due to a flaw in the collision of the ticket gates.

notes.title: 2025/3/15「Correction of defects, etc」ver.1.0.1
notes.notes:
・Fixed a problem in which the notes used to solve the riddle of the vault were very difficult to see, depending on the graphic quality setting.
・The time delay between being illuminated by the light and being sucked into “She” was too short, which did not fit the playing experience of “blocking the light and dealing with the situation”.
